settings.hero_heading: For the First Hour & the Last
settings.intro_body:
Soft Hours is built around a single idea: what you wear when you enter and exit the day should be treated with care, intention, and patience.

The spark for Soft Hours arrived on a phone call between two women, eight thousand kilometres and an hour apart, talking about business ventures.

What followed: how to make something exact enough to be worn out of the bedroom and soft enough to stay in it. How to design for the most private hours of her day, without making her disappear into them.
settings.founder_body:
When I started this journey, I did not know where it would lead. All I knew is that I wanted to create something special for all women who carry so much, daily. Something they will love, keep, and make them feel beautiful, during the intimate hours of their day.

I started my career working in investment banking - a very high-pressure environment. Slowing down, and not making what is happening around me dictate my internal state, has become a superpower for me. I truly think there is nothing more powerful than coming home to oneself, and I believe we should all feel elegant and a little "femme fatale" while doing so.

— Marion —
settings.patience_body: Every mind, hand, and heart involved has been integral in bringing Soft Hours to life: the fabric makers, the design team, the brand designers, and the photographers, to name just a few. Verified maker and location details will be added as they are approved.
